description: Defines overlay widget classes and enums for ANGLE project, including widget types, IDs, and specific widget classes like Count, PerSecond, Text, RunningGraph, and RunningHistogram.

classes.name: Widget
classes.description: Base class for overlay widgets, containing common properties and virtual destructor.

classes.name: Count
classes.description: Widget subclass representing a count of events, with methods to add and reset count.

classes.name: PerSecond
classes.description: Subclass of Count, representing a per-second metric.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Widget subclass for displaying text, with method to set string content.

classes.name: RunningGraph
classes.description: Widget subclass for displaying a running graph of values, with methods to add values and move to next.

classes.name: RunningHistogram
classes.description: Subclass of RunningGraph for histogram display, setting values based on a float input.

classes.name: Dummy
classes.description: No-op class used when overlay is disabled.

methods.name: RunningGraph(size_t n)
methods.description: Constructor for RunningGraph, initializes with size n.

methods.name: set(float n)
methods.description: Sets the histogram value based on a float between 0 and 1.

methods.name: reset()
methods.description: Resets the count or widget state.

methods.name: add(size_t n)
methods.description: Adds a value to the widget's count or graph.

methods.name: next()
methods.description: Advances to the next position in the graph or histogram.

methods.name: set(std::string &&str)
methods.description: Sets the text content of a Text widget.
